citations.assessment: The checked text reports that the disqualification befell him and somebody else was appointed, with the difficult ‘in the high priest’ expression also present.
The parallel instead has Yosef ben Elam appointed as substitute for the disqualified high priest. Preserve the contrast.
Yerushalmi Yoma presents Ben Illem of Sepphoris substituting on the Day of Atonement.
